categories.parameter binding: Exact argument slot one enters its resolved target and selected call context.
categories.caller argument binding: A formal sink expands to its caller argument slot one without an initially selected callee frame; exact resolved target identity is checked.
categories.parameter use: The parameter supplies a value use in the same method.
categories.storage write: The actual setter assignment uses the RHS in argument slot two; field declaration code is not the stored value.
categories.exceptional memory effect exit: Stored state crosses a failed call or resumed thrown exit; this is not an exception payload or scalar return dependency.
categories.resolved call exit: The method identity matches the resolved caller target; void setters/helpers carry memory effects, getters/read return scalar values.
categories.storage continuation: Invisible entry evidence resumes CFG storage traversal at the selected caller; completed unrelated-slot cleanup does not kill the requested slot.
categories.method exit evidence: Return/normal completion carries stored state or a scalar value; cleanup return replacement in suppress resumes normal caller execution.
categories.returned value: The getter/read value supplies its explicit return operand.
categories.assignment or use: Source/evaluation temporary storage supplies a later use without reevaluation.
categories.saved field copy: The other-field getter value supplies the saved RHS temporary before the value-field setter.

limitations: All transitions of the returned paths are retained; the bound does not enumerate every execution or CFG predecessor. Private pending-exit demands are not serialized in the existing witness schema; exitModes retain producer evidence.

Initialization guards, external effects and implicit runtime exceptions remain diagnosed. Zero paths for joinedNormal is a matching endpoint observation with a positive control, but an inconclusive semantic absence under the reported limits. joinedArgument and copiedArgument share the exact source endpoints and prove the selected callee input bindings; the caught controls additionally check actual runtime storage delivery.

copiedNormal is a known false positive: its source store occurs only on otherBranch's thrown exit, while copiedCleanup's caller requires normal completion. The ordinary RHS task loses this correlation when it reads Shared.other.

copiedCaught is the nearby runtime/graph positive control. The execution oracle observes normal copy for false and a thrown exit for true; it never observes an input-valued normal return from copiedNormal.
No initialization, complete heap, callback lifecycle or general exception-feasibility claim follows.
